prompts.text: Who are the expansive people in your life?
What exact quality — not achievement — draws you?
Where does that quality already appear quietly in you?
Who is the part of you that recognizes this reflection?

blocks.title: The letter of recognition
blocks.instruction: Write a short letter telling one of your expansive people what you see in them. Then address one paragraph of the same recognition to yourself.

blocks.closing: The mirror was there all along. What you recognize in the reflection draws you closer.
